creator: Alexander Terp
description:
`kan migrate` calls `discovery.DiscoverProject` with an empty global config (`internal/cli/migrate.go`), so it ignores a custom `data_location` and skips the worktree redirect. Run in a linked worktree, it migrates the worktree's copy instead of the shared board.

Design: `docs/design/work-across-boards.md`, section "Read commands never write inside a project", next to last paragraph.
title: kan migrate: discover the project the way other commands do
